```artifact
Feature: Alarm System Functionality

  Scenario: High Leakage Alarm Activation
    Given the system is monitoring leakage
    When the average leakage over 10 seconds is 3.1 L/min
    Then the "high leakage" alarm should be active

  Scenario Outline: High Leakage Alarm Activation with Different Averages
    Given the system is monitoring leakage
    When the average leakage over <seconds> seconds is <average> L/min
    Then the "high leakage" alarm should be <active>
    Examples:
      | seconds | average | active |
      | 10      | 3.1     | active |
      | 10      | 3.0     | inactive |
      | 10      | 2.9     | inactive |
      | 10      | 3.0001  | active |

  Scenario: High Leakage Alarm Priority
    Given the "high leakage" alarm is active
    Then the "high leakage" alarm should have high priority

  Scenario: Involuntary Shutdown Alarm Tone
    Given the system is in an involuntary shutdown state
    Then the "involuntary shutdown" alarm should emit a continuous-tone alarm

  Scenario: Involuntary Shutdown Alarm Duration
    Given the system is in an involuntary shutdown state
    Then the "involuntary shutdown" alarm should emit a sound tone for at least 2 minutes

  Scenario: Continuous-Tone Alarm Support
    Given the system is configured to support continuous-tone alarms
    When an alarm condition is met
    Then the system should emit a continuous-tone alarm

  Scenario: Detection of AC Mains Loss
    Given the AC mains power loss sensor is connected
    When the AC mains power is lost
    Then the GUI should detect the loss of AC mains

  Scenario: Connection to AC Mains Power Loss Sensor
    Given the GUI is connected to the "AC mains power loss" sensor
    When the AC mains power is lost
    Then the GUI should receive a signal indicating AC mains power loss

  Scenario: AC Mains Power Loss Alarm Priority
    Given the AC mains power loss alarm is active
    Then the AC mains power loss alarm should have medium priority
```
